dimensions.reasons: The Group C author animation frames clearly show the intended subject: a centered pale-cyan lotion pump bottle with a blank front label, silver pump assembly, downward-curved nozzle, and neutral studio setting. The bottle silhouette, shoulder, neck/collar, and dispenser are recognizable. However, frames 0001 through 0016 remain visually identical despite prominent asymmetric cues from the label and nozzle, so the requested 360-degree turntable is not demonstrated.
issues: No visible rotation across the sampled animation sequence.
The presentation is substantially washed out, reducing the clean product-showcase effect.
The requested threaded 24/410 neck is not visibly modeled or exposed.

dimensions.reasons: In Group C frame_0001, the bottle is upright, visibly rests on the floor plane, and casts a soft contact shadow. The collar, stem, pump head, and curved spout appear continuously connected. The main structural assembly reads as physically supported.
issues: The white label panel appears very thin and visibly proud of, or partially intersecting with, the curved bottle in Group A wide_front and wide_back.
The exact bottle wall thickness and threaded neck construction are not evident in the visible renders.

dimensions.reasons: The rendered object is independently recognizable as a cosmetic pump bottle rather than a generic primitive. Group C frame_0001 shows a light-cyan frosted/translucent body, broad blank white label area, and a bright silver dispenser with a clearly curved downward nozzle.
issues: The metal assembly is so bright that its form and finish are partly lost against the backdrop.
The pump head and collar are simplified and oversized-looking relative to a detailed 24/410 cosmetic pump.
No fine thread detailing is visible at the neck.

dimensions.reasons: The Group C final frames have a coherent product-render arrangement with a soft floor shadow and plausible overall bottle construction. However, the whole image is low contrast and overexposed; body boundaries, the label edge, and the pump material read more softly than a refined commercial product render.
issues: Washed-out lighting makes the bottle blend into the background.
The silver material has noisy/grainy-looking dark patches rather than convincingly controlled brushed-metal detail.
The label reads as a thin applied sheet instead of a cleanly integrated label surface.

dimensions.reasons: The bottle is centered, upright, and isolated against a neutral studio floor/backdrop in Group C frame_0001. The label is placed on the front/lower-middle body and the nozzle projects outward from the center-mounted pump, which matches the intended basic object relationships.
issues: The final camera view is closer to a frontal product view than a strong slightly top-down 3/4 view.
The lack of demonstrated turntable rotation prevents confirmation of the intended all-around presentation.
Some evaluator wide views reveal an open floor horizon and black upper background, although the author animation frames themselves present a cleaner seamless gradient.

dimensions.reasons: The visible body is tall and narrow, with a rounded shoulder and total height that appears roughly consistent with a cosmetic pump bottle substantially taller than its 40 mm body diameter. The body-to-pump relationship is generally believable in Group C frame_0001.
issues: The silver collar/cap appears comparatively tall and broad for the narrow neck.
The simplified pump head is somewhat blocky and large relative to the bottle body.
Exact stated dimensions cannot be verified from the renders.

dimensions.reasons: Group C frame_0001 shows soft studio-style illumination, a light-gray-to-white background gradient, and a grounded soft shadow. The body visibly carries a pale cyan translucent/frosted treatment, while the pump clearly reads as reflective silver.
issues: The exposure is too high, so light does not cleanly separate the bottle from the backdrop.
The frosted glass reads somewhat milky and indistinct rather than as well-controlled semi-transparent glass.
Fine brushed-metal reflections are not clearly visible; the pump's highlights are largely blown out or mottled.

dimensions.reasons: The key static components are present in the renders: bottle body, rounded shoulder, neck/collar, silver pump stem/head, curved nozzle, blank label panel, supporting floor, and neutral studio environment. The major missing deliverable evidence is the requested rotating turntable: all 16 Group C samples retain the same label and nozzle orientation.
issues: No visible 360-degree rotation in the sampled animation frames.
No visible thread detail for the specified 24/410 neck.
The label treatment is present but looks like an incomplete thin panel rather than a polished, integrated label area.

criteria.criterion: The bottle body must jointly satisfy its specified geometry, dimensions, shoulder transition, and complete frosted-glass appearance.
The neck, mounted collar, pump head, nozzle, metal response, closed state, and overall height must form one complete specified dispenser system.
The bottle front must provide the specified continuous and visibly blank label footprint.
The final animation must combine the specified soft studio environment with controlled product readability and separation.
criteria.evidence: The final-animation frames use a pale gray, apparently seamless studio-style gradient with soft floor shadows and broad highlights, but the bottle, silver collar, and white label are consistently very low contrast and visibly washed out. In frame_0001 and frame_0016, the pale cyan body has weak separation from the light background and much of the metal/label reads nearly white, reducing controlled product readability.

criteria.criterion: The actual animation camera must provide the specified perspective, slightly top-down three-quarter view, and resulting sense of depth.
The complete recognizable product must perform the required centered full-revolution turntable motion as a continuous constant-speed loop.
The actual video file must jointly satisfy the requested format, exact square resolution, duration, and effective frame rate.
The retained Blender project must be valid, editable, re-angleable, complete, and natively configured for the requested Cycles animation.

notes: The static product is clearly recognizable as a frosted cyan cosmetic pump bottle and has the main requested parts. Its principal weaknesses are the undemonstrated turntable motion, overbright low-contrast rendering, simplified unthreaded pump/neck detail, and a visibly raised or intersecting label panel.
score_policy: Frozen paper score: uncapped 0.5 rubric + 0.5 dimension.
